notes.title: The Glitch Fairy Artbook DLC is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
The Glitch Fairy: Game & Artbook Bundle

This bundle includes :

-The Glitch Fairy (game)

-The Glitch Fairy Artbook DLC

Making The Glitch Fairy was a long journey, and we want to share its history with you!

This PDF artbook contains over 400 pages of cut content, concept art, promo art, dev commentary, level plans, and more!

We also included a new, canon illustrated short story that covers the backstory of Anabelle (23 pages).

INSTRUCTIONS TO OPEN THE PDF BOOK

The PDF (artbook) will be downloaded to your The Glitch Fairy Steam folder.

You can access it quickly by right-clicking The Glitch Fairy in your Steam library, then hover over "Manage", then clicking on "Browse local files".

A window will pop up, and you should see the PDF file, named The Glitch Fairy Artbook.

notes.title: French Update!
notes.notes:
It's time to reach out to more Fairies around the world!

The Glitch Fairy can now be played in French, and is more accessible with the new Story mode!

The game will auto-detect if your Steam is in English or French but you can also change the language on the world map menu.

Story mode makes you start the game with 4 additional hearts and lowers the KO penalty to 1 coin instead of five.

This update also includes some polish and bug fixing.
